title: One call: four layers, then allow, hold or block
lede: A call arrives with a token. The token is verified, four scope checks read only the verified claims, and policy is asked two questions: may this proceed attended, may it proceed unattended. Allow-then-deny holds the call for a person: it is refused at once, an approver signs, and the retry proceeds. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Four scope checks: surface, application, action, end user
Approver: Slack DM, Ping push, Jira or ServiceNow

edges.label: Hold: refused now, reference and expiry
Signs: bound to the exact call
Retry: the grant is an input

steps.title: Call with a token
steps.what: {{castAgent}} calls {{castToolHold}} on {{castApp}} for {{castUser}}, presenting a token. The surface is derived from the route, not from anything the caller says.

steps.title: The token is verified
steps.what: The signature, issuer, audience and lifetime are checked. From here on only the verified claims are read.

steps.title: Four scope checks pass
steps.what: Surface (the identity caps the key), application and required claims, action scope, and the end user, in that order. Each can stop the call.

steps.title: Hold: refused now
steps.what: Allowed attended, refused unattended: a hold. The call is refused at once with a reason, a reference and an owning expiry. Nothing is held open.

steps.title: The request goes to approvers
steps.what: A Slack DM, a Ping push or a ticket (simulated outbox, never sent) reaches people who hold the named role.

steps.title: An approver signs
steps.what: Single-use and bound to the canonical hash of method, target and arguments, or to a fixed period; the number of approvers, roles and minimum sign-in strength are checked.

steps.title: The agent retries
steps.what: The same call again. The grant is an input to this evaluation: it lifts the hold, and nothing above it.

steps.title: Allowed: the call is made
steps.what: The attended form is satisfied and the grant is spent (single-use) or counted (period).

steps.title: The request is examined
steps.what: Rules that read inspection findings can refuse the call here. They cannot hold it.

steps.title: The reply is examined
steps.what: A finding on the reply can withhold the result. It cannot hold it either.
